channels_moved_to_https.name: channels_moved_to_https
channels_moved_to_https.value: ("channels"."moved_to" is null) = ("channels"."moved_at" is null) and ("channels"."moved_to" is null or ("channels"."moved_to" ~ '^https://' and length("channels"."moved_to") <= 500))

playback_sessions_scoring_idx.name: playback_sessions_scoring_idx
playback_sessions_scoring_idx.where: "playback_sessions"."ended_at" is null or "playback_sessions"."verdict" = 'pending' or "playback_sessions"."scored_at" is null

evidence_objects_storage.name: evidence_objects_storage
evidence_objects_storage.value: ("evidence_objects"."storage" = 'inline' and "evidence_objects"."sealed" is not null and "evidence_objects"."storage_key" is null and octet_length("evidence_objects"."sealed") <= 1049600) or ("evidence_objects"."storage" = 'bucket' and "evidence_objects"."storage_key" is not null and "evidence_objects"."sealed" is null)

moderation_flags_signal.name: moderation_flags_signal
moderation_flags_signal.value: ("moderation_flags"."origin" = 'human') or ("moderation_flags"."origin" = 'hash_list' and "moderation_flags"."tier" = 't0' and "moderation_flags"."list_category" is not null and "moderation_flags"."distance" is not null) or ("moderation_flags"."origin" = 'classifier' and "moderation_flags"."tier" in ('t1', 't2') and "moderation_flags"."category" is not null and "moderation_flags"."score" is not null)

event_subscriptions_transport_ck.name: event_subscriptions_transport_ck
event_subscriptions_transport_ck.value: ("event_subscriptions"."transport" = 'webhook') = ("event_subscriptions"."callback_url" is not null and "event_subscriptions"."secret_ciphertext" is not null) and ("event_subscriptions"."transport" = 'websocket') = ("event_subscriptions"."websocket_session_id" is not null)

oauth_apps_suspension_ck.name: oauth_apps_suspension_ck
oauth_apps_suspension_ck.value: ("oauth_apps"."suspended_at" is null) = ("oauth_apps"."suspended_reason" is null) and ("oauth_apps"."suspended_at" is null) = ("oauth_apps"."suspended_by_id" is null)

oauth_tokens_app_only_ck.name: oauth_tokens_app_only_ck
oauth_tokens_app_only_ck.value: ("oauth_tokens"."user_id" is null) = ("oauth_tokens"."kind" = 'client_credentials') and ("oauth_tokens"."user_id" is not null or ("oauth_tokens"."refresh_token_hash" is null and cardinality("oauth_tokens"."scopes") = 0))

loyalty_tx_sign_ck.name: loyalty_tx_sign_ck
loyalty_tx_sign_ck.value:
("loyalty_transactions"."reason" in ('watch', 'prediction_payout', 'prediction_refund') and "loyalty_transactions"."delta" > 0)
       or ("loyalty_transactions"."reason" in ('command', 'prediction_bet', 'poll_vote') and "loyalty_transactions"."delta" < 0)
       or "loyalty_transactions"."reason" = 'moderator_adjust'

giveaways_text.name: giveaways_text
giveaways_text.value: length("giveaways"."title") between 1 and 60 and length("giveaways"."prize") between 1 and 200

watch_rooms_invite_live.name: watch_rooms_invite_live
watch_rooms_invite_live.value: "watch_rooms"."invite_hash" is not null or "watch_rooms"."ended_at" is not null
